app.name: OrbitDrop
wheel.instructions: Use the arrow keys to choose and Enter to run. Press Esc to close.
wheel.empty: Nothing is available for this file.
mode.label: Menu type
picker.title: OrbitDrop
picker.unsupportedHint: Use images (JPG, PNG, WebP and more) or PDF files.
picker.someUnusable.one: {count} file can't be processed and will be skipped.
picker.someUnusable.other: {count} files can't be processed and will be skipped.
picker.noTools: There are no tools for this file type. Try Convert.
dropzone.title: Drop Zone
dropzone.notFiles: Only files can be dropped here.
editor.previewFailed: Couldn't render the preview. Showing the last one.
editor.outputName: Saved next to the original as “{name}”.
editor.applyToAll.one: The same settings apply to {count} file.
editor.applyToAll.other: The same settings apply to all {count} files.
editor.unsaved.title: Close without saving?
editor.format.resolved: With “original format”, a {from} file is saved as {to}.
crop.selectionHelp: Arrow keys move the area (10× with Shift); {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
crop.error.ratio: With this ratio the maximum is {max} px.
bg.note.ratio: To match the ratio, the padding on one side is wider than the setting.
bg.note.shadow: The padding was widened so the shadow isn't cut off.
bg.note.corners: The corner radius is applied as {radius} px to fit the image.
bg.note.reduced: Padding and shadow didn't fit within the maximum size, so the padding was reduced to {padding} px.
bg.note.maxEdge: The longest side is at most {maxEdge} px (change it in Settings). The image is never enlarged.
bg.jpegNote: JPEG can't store transparency, so the background is saved opaque.
compress.pngHint: For PNG the size is controlled by the mode instead of quality.
compress.someNotSmaller.one: {count} file won't get smaller than its original. You may want to keep that original.
compress.someNotSmaller.other: {count} files won't get smaller than their originals. You may want to keep those originals.
compress.batchSmaller: Expected to be {percent}% smaller in total.
compress.batchNotSmaller: In total the results won't be smaller than the originals. Change the settings or keep the originals.
compress.notSmaller: It won't be smaller than the original. Change the settings or keep the original.
compress.resultNotSmaller: The result isn't smaller than the original (+{percent}%). You may want to keep the original.
meta.gpsWarning: This image contains location (GPS) data. Consider removing it before sharing.
meta.icc.convert: Convert to sRGB and remove the profile (recommended)
meta.stripInfo: Creates a new copy without EXIF, XMP, IPTC and thumbnails. The photo's orientation is applied to the pixels, so it looks the same. The original isn't changed.
annotate.help: Pick a tool, then drag on the image. For text, click where it should go. Enter confirms, Shift+Enter adds a line.
annotate.added.arrow: Arrow added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys move its tip.
annotate.added.rect: Rectangle added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
annotate.keysHelp: Keyboard: insert with the Add buttons, move with the arrow keys (Shift ×10), resize with {alt}+arrow keys, Delete removes, Enter edits text.
annotate.unsaved: Your annotations haven't been saved yet. They'll be lost if you close.
annotate.fontUnreadable.one: {count} text annotation can't be drawn at all with the installed fonts and won't be visible in the result.
annotate.fontUnreadable.other: {count} text annotations can't be drawn at all with the installed fonts and won't be visible in the result.
redact.help: Drag over the areas you want to hide.
redact.mosaicNote: Mosaic isn't guaranteed to remove the information. Use a solid box for sensitive content.
redact.empty: Mark at least one area to hide.
redact.metadataNote: Redactions are burned into the final pixels, and the result keeps no original thumbnail or metadata.
redact.added: Area added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
redact.keysHelp: Keyboard: insert with Add area, move with the arrow keys (Shift ×10), resize with {alt}+arrow keys, Delete removes.
redact.unsaved: The areas you marked haven't been saved yet. They'll be lost if you close.
pdf.help: Drag or use the arrow buttons to change the order. Each image becomes one page.
pdf.keysHelp: {alt}+Up/Down arrows reorder the pages; Up/Down arrows move between rows.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.emptyHint: Drag a file in Finder while holding a modifier key, or drop a file on the Drop Zone.
jobs.retryUnavailable: Can't retry: the original file is missing, or the job ran before OrbitDrop restarted. Open the file again.
jobs.clearFinishedHint: Removes completed, failed and cancelled jobs from the list and history. Result files stay where they are.
jobs.emptyHintPc: Drag a file in File Explorer while holding a modifier key, or drop a file on the Drop Zone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.notifications: Notify me when a job started by dragging finishes
settings.notice.settingsReset: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults apply. The old file was kept in the app data folder as {file}.
settings.notice.settingsReset.noBackup: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults apply.
settings.notice.historyReset: The job history file could not be read, so the history started empty. The old file was kept in the app data folder as {file}.
settings.notice.historyReset.noBackup: The job history file could not be read, so the history started empty.
settings.notice.translated: The Intel (x64) build of OrbitDrop is running under Rosetta 2. This Mac needs the Apple silicon (arm64) build — it starts faster, and macOS is ending support for Intel apps.
settings.globalDrag: Open the wheel with a modifier key while dragging a file
settings.keysHint: Hold these keys while dragging to open the wheel.
settings.keysMacNote: On macOS, Control and Command can't be used: holding them turns the drag into a link instead of a copy, so the wheel can't accept the drop.
settings.keysWinNote: On Windows, Alt+Shift also switches the input language and releasing the Windows key opens Start. A combination that doesn't overlap is recommended.
settings.keys.warn.altShift: Alt+Shift overlaps the input-language switch: the input language may change while you drag.
settings.keys.warn.winKey: Releasing the Windows key may open Start.
settings.keys.error.same: The Convert and Tools menus need different key combinations.
settings.keys.error.macUnsupported: Control and Command don't work on macOS. Choose other keys.
settings.wheelPreviewCaption: Shown at {percent}% of actual size · dashed rings mark the smallest and largest size
settings.helper.noGlobalDrag: The helper is running, but global drag isn't available: {reason}
settings.helper.permissionSteps: Allow OrbitDrop in System Settings › Privacy & Security, then restart the app.
settings.helper.fallback: Meanwhile, the Drop Zone and Open Files offer the same features.
settings.inputMonitoring.note: Without Input Monitoring, Esc closes the wheel only while the pointer is over it. To close it with Esc anywhere, allow OrbitDrop in System Settings.
settings.numberError: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
about.title: About OrbitDrop
about.tagline: Drag a file and pick from the ring. Everything is processed on this computer.
